headline: War in Iran and Strait of Hormuz Instability Rattle Global Energy Markets
summary: An ongoing conflict in Iran, marked by recent strikes, is significantly impacting global energy markets and raising concerns about sustained disruptions to oil exports through the critical Strait of Hormuz. This regional instability directly influences global inflation, increasing operational costs for all supply chains, including the energy-intensive AI infrastructure and semiconductor sectors.
